source_documents.title: Silica shelled and block copolymer encapsulated red-emissive AIE nanoparticles with 50% quantum yield for two-photon excited vascular imaging

reference_evidence_units.quote: When fw reaches 90%, the corresponding fluorescence intensities of TPETPAFN and TPE are increased up to 70-fold and 86-fold, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Main text reports 70-fold TPETPAFN enhancement at 90% water in THF/water; 86-fold belongs to TPE.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Raw Figure S1 not inspected; intensities are not absolute quantum yields.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission maximum of TPETPAFN is red-shifted from 597 nm in hexane to 643 nm in toluene and 652 nm in THF
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPETPAFN red-shifts and weakens as solvent polarity increases.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main reports SI solvent spectra; these are solution measurements, not nanoparticle emission peaks.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign TPETPAFN's solvent-dependent emission to ICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Phenomenological ICT assignment; no specific TICT geometry or electron-transfer reaction established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The obtained AIE-F127 NPs were further coated with a silica shell by a sol-gel procedure.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: THF-dissolved F127/dye are dried, redispersed by sonication in water, then silica-coated and dialyzed.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Encapsulation is an engineered matrix, not a demonstrated stoichiometric host-cavity inclusion complex.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPETPAFN-F127-SiO2 NPs ( = 50 ± 1%) display much higher brightness than that of TPETPAFN- F127 NPs (24 ± 1%).
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Silica coating raises nanoparticle yield from 24 +/- 1% to 50 +/- 1% at similar absorbance; emission shifts from 655 to 641 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 1 inspected. The figure citation in prose says 1B for peak positions, but spectra are in 1A.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No obvious fluorescence enhancement has been observed for TPE based NPs with and without SiO2 coating
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-F127 and TPE-F127-SiO2 nanoparticles
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPE comparator yields change only from 21 +/- 1% to 23 +/- 1%, unlike TPETPAFN.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparator values are not transferred to TPETPAFN; this control supports a polarity-dependent effect.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the average fluorescence lifetime of TPETPAFN-F127-SiO2 NPs (4.18 ns, Table S1) is more than twice longer
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPETPAFN mean lifetime rises from 1.81 ns without silica to 4.18 ns with silica.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table S1 values are reported in main, not personally inspected; Figure 1B provides the visible decay comparison.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The protective silica layer thus provides a relatively less polar environment for TPETPAFN by minimizing its contact with water.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The proposed shell mechanism is a less-polar microenvironment and reduced water contact.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Water/oxygen shielding is inferred; no direct oxygen titration, local polarity measurement or binding constant is supplied.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The longer lifetime of TPETPAFN-F127-SiO2 NPs should be due to blocking of nonradiative decay pathways
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPETPAFN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TPETPAFN in organic solvents and aqueous F127 nanoparticles, with and without silica shell; TPE particles as polarity-insensitive comparator.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors attribute joint lifetime/yield enhancement to reduced nonradiative loss, assuming roughly invariant radiative rate.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source assumption of constant intrinsic radiative rate is not independently demonstrated. This does not specifically identify intramolecular rotation as the silica-shell effect.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: F127/silica environmental shielding is the main intervention and proposed origin of enhancement.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Polarity-sensitive ICT emission explains why TPETPAFN benefits more than the TPE comparator.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source explicitly interprets the lifetime/yield pair as reduced knr under a near-constant-kr assumption; it is a bounded kinetic account.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: General TPE rotation background and AIE intensity trends do not independently establish internal-motion restriction as the silica-induced enhancement mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: F127/silica environmental shielding is the main intervention and proposed origin of enhancement.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Matrix encapsulation and exclusion of water are not specific guest binding or host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Polarity-sensitive ICT emission explains why TPETPAFN benefits more than the TPE comparator.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton or excimer mechanism is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source explicitly interprets the lifetime/yield pair as reduced knr under a near-constant-kr assumption; it is a bounded kinetic account.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No operative target-specific triplet or metal-mediated pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
